name: Maintained normally-open contact
summary: A maintained NO contact retains the actuated closed position according to its mechanism or control arrangement.
description: A maintained NO contact retains the actuated closed position according to its mechanism or control arrangement. The drawing needs the release or reset action in addition to the unactuated contact state.
readingNotes: Identify how the maintained position is released.
